类 LogoutServlet

所有已实现的接口:
Serializable, javax.servlet.Servlet, javax.servlet.ServletConfig
@WebServlet(name="LogoutServlet", urlPatterns="/logout") public class LogoutServlet extends BaseServlet
Servlet handling user logout requests.

Mapped URL: /logout
Invalidates the current session, clears the login state, and redirects to the home page.

    • doGet

      protected void doGet(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req, javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse resp) throws javax.servlet.ServletException, IOException
      Handles GET requests to perform the logout operation.

      If a valid session exists, invalidates it; finally redirects to the application home page.

      覆盖:
      doGet 在类中 javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
      参数:
      req - HTTP request
      resp - HTTP response
      抛出:
      javax.servlet.ServletException - if a Servlet exception occurs during forwarding
      IOException - if an IO error occurs during redirect
